protocol: Held-out real public sites; Goals fixed before Jev runs; no production edits during trials
head: 2852e6846f8612877c42d04a2560049cd6891331
execution: sequential, fresh browser/context per trial, 2000ms action interval, no action cap
scope: Same-origin public reading only. No form submissions, login, reservations, purchases, contacting operators, admin paths or publishing screenshots. Selected old sources only for completion/outcome checks. No OCR or DOM text to Jev.
permissionLimit: No explicit operator permission is claimed; robots allowance/absence is not blanket authorization. Limited low-impact reading only; existing safeguards stop at unsupported content, disallowed navigation or 401/403/429. Policy review is conservative, not legal clearance.

cases.goal: KIITOに来館したい。通常の休館日を知りたい。申し込みはしない。
初めて彫刻の森美術館に行きたい。開館時間、一般の入館料、最寄り駅からの行き方を知りたい。予約・購入はしない。
10人で打ち合わせできる貸室を探し、その部屋の定員と利用料金が分かる案内を開きたい。予約はしない。

policyReview.rule: Only /wordpress/wp-admin/ disallowed; admin and form use excluded
policyReview.finding: Public privacy policy reviewed; no explicit public-reading automation permission claimed
Public privacy policy reviewed; no applicable public-reading automation prohibition found. A missing robots file is not permission.

excluded.reason: Article 7(3) restricts scraping/crawling; excluded conservatively despite robots AI-crawler allowances
Top-page preflight timed out; omitted rather than increase traffic or bypass access
robots excludes search/cgi-bin; current unchanged runner lacks path-specific robots enforcement, so omitted

evaluation: Retain every trial, original ending and audit errors. Model classifications are not objective facts. Afterwards inspect actual selected images for each requested substantive item; distinguish display exposure, conditional policy, unresolved detail and tool/scope failures. No manual route/expected answer is passed to Jev. Two related cultural facilities do not establish cross-industry generalization.
